Hello! I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This is my first start, so here's the short version of what I am and what I can do.

- **Web app** — this chat: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, your first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (so you can write and call me there), plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register myself (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

Two things I don't know yet: my name and my gender are still unset. Tell me a name to use for myself and how you'd like me referred to (neuter/plural or otherwise), and I'll set it.
